config.questsPerDay.tooltip: How many quests appear on the help-wanted board each day (1-20).
config.specialOrdersBoardPages.tooltip: How many pages of orders the SpecialOrders board displays. 1 keeps vanilla behaviour (the two random orders vanilla picked at the weekly refresh). 2 to 5 enables a paginated view that surfaces every eligible order from every loaded mod, two per page, with prev/next arrows. Other mods' orders are never evicted; they appear naturally in the rotation.
config.section.weights.tooltip: Each daily-board quest type has a relative weight. Higher = more likely to appear. 0 disables that type. Browse by category below.
config.weight.tooltip: Selection weight for {{id}} (0 disables, higher = more likely).
config.page.weights.tooltip: Selection weights for every {{category}} quest registered for the daily board.
config.weight.Vanilla.SlayMonster.constr: Mines unlocked and at least 5 days played.
config.weight.Mining.BarDelivery.constra: Mining level 1 or higher and reached mine floor 40.
config.weight.Cooking.CravingDish.constr: You know at least one cooking recipe.
config.weight.Animal.HaySupplyRun.constr: Animal quests toggle is on and you own at least 4 animals.
config.weight.Fishing.LegendaryFish.cons: Fishing level 6 or higher and you've met Willy.
config.weight.Farming.PierresStockUp.con: Farming level 4 or higher and Pierre exists.
Foraging level 3 or higher, you've met Caroline, and you're at least 1 heart with her.
config.weight.Mining.MonsterParts.constr: Combat level 2 or higher and reached mine floor 40.
config.weight.Mining.MinesDeepDive.const: Mining level 1 or higher and reached mine floor 5.
config.weight.Mining.SkullCavernDeepDive: Reached the Skull Cavern (cleared mine floor 120).
You've met at least one child NPC (Jas, Vincent, Leo, etc.).
config.difficultyScaling.tooltip: When on, harder quest variants unlock based on your skill levels.
config.fishingIgnoresVisitedLocations.to: When off (default), fishing quests only request fish that spawn somewhere you've been. Turn on if you want quests to potentially send you somewhere new.
config.foragingIgnoresVisitedLocations.t: When off (default), foraging quests (seasonal forage, rare hunt, Caroline's tea, Winter Star feast) only request items that spawn somewhere you've been. Turn on if you want quests to potentially send you somewhere new.
config.allowDuplicateGiverPerDay: Same NPC can give multiple quests
config.allowDuplicateGiverPerDay.tooltip: When on, the same villager can post multiple different item delivery or fishing quests in the same day. Default off.
config.skipFriendshipQuestsAtMaxHeart: Skip friendship quests at max hearts
config.skipFriendshipQuestsAtMaxHeart.to: When on (default), quests that reward friendship to a specific villager are hidden once you've maxed out their hearts.
config.section.exclusions.tooltip: NPCs listed here will never post quests on the help-wanted board or the special orders board. Useful for friendable monsters or pets that ship as if they were real villagers, or just for any NPC you'd rather not get quests from.
config.ineligibleGivers.tooltip: Comma-separated list of internal NPC names (e.g. Krobus, Leximonster, SenS). Use the internal name from the game data, not the display name. Defaults cover friendable monsters from common packs.
config.mailFallbackForExcludedGivers.too: When on (default), a daily-board quest with a hardcoded giver who's on the excluded list is sent to your mailbox instead of being dropped. You still get the quest, just by letter. When off, the quest is skipped entirely. Either way, a warning line is written to the SMAPI log so mod authors notice. Special-order quests can never fall back to mail, so this setting doesn't affect them.
config.FriendshipBasic.tooltip: Small reward (default 30, about 12% of a heart).
config.FriendshipMid.tooltip: Default 80, about a third of a heart.
config.FriendshipMultiSmall.tooltip: Per-NPC amount when rewarding multiple NPCs at once.
config.FriendshipMultiHeart.tooltip: Per-NPC amount for festival quests rewarding all NPCs in a village mod.
config.GoldExpertBase.tooltip: Reward for expert / Grand Feast scale quests.
config.RewardMultiplierBelowSell.tooltip: Reward = item sell price x this. Used for high-volume bulk quests like Massive Harvest.
config.RewardMultiplierAboveSell.tooltip: Reward = item sell price x this. Used for cooking and artisan delivery quests.
config.RewardMultiplierFishPremium.toolt: Reward = fish sell price x this. Used for expert fishing hauls.
config.DeadlineShort.tooltip: Tight deadline for festival prep and urgent daily quests.
config.DeadlineLong.tooltip: Extended deadline for advanced or multi-step quests.
config.DeadlineExtended.tooltip: Long deadline for rare-trigger quests where the item is hard to obtain.
config.ConsequenceGraceDays.tooltip: How many days past a queued reaction's fire day before it silently expires. Lower = NPCs forget faster; higher = grudges last longer. Default 7.
config.debugLogging.tooltip: Writes detailed diagnostic lines to the SMAPI log file. Off by default. Turn this on if you're chasing a bug and want to share a log; otherwise it just adds noise.
quest.reward.label: Reward
quest.reward.line.friendship.collapsed: Word will get around — a few villagers will warm up to you
quest.reward.line.item: You will get {{item}} as a thank you
quest.reward.line.mail: {{npc}} will send you a letter in the next few days
quest.reward.line.shopDiscount: {{npc}} will mark down their shop {{percent}}% for {{days}} day(s)
quest.reward.line.animalPurchaseDiscount: {{npc}} will mark down livestock {{percent}}% for {{days}} day(s)
quest.reward.line.festivalBias.luau: {{npc}} will put in a good word for you with the governor at the Luau
quest.reward.line.festivalBias.fair: {{npc}} says your contribution will give the grange judges something to talk about
quest.reward.line.fairStarTokens: {{npc}} will slip you {{amount}} extra star tokens to spend at the Fair
quest.itemDelivery.partial.thanks: Thanks! Bring me {{remaining}} more when you can.
config.section.mailQuestChances.tooltip: Per-quest chance (0 to 100) for mail-delivered quests that gate on a trigger condition. 100 = always fire when the trigger matches, 0 disables the quest.
config.page.mailChances.tooltip: Open the per-quest mail chance sliders.
config.mailChance.Fishing.RainyDayCatchM: Chance (0 to 100) that the Rainy Day Catch quest mail arrives on a day where tomorrow is forecast as rain. 100 = always when rain is forecast, 0 disables the quest.
